title: Scribe Content — agent input
description: Written by the scribe agent to .github/.pipeline-context/scribe/<story_id>.content.json after reading <story_id>.chain.facts.md, then consumed by scripts/render-scribe.js to produce both docs/agent_output/06-ship/audit_<id>.md and docs/agent_output/06-ship/pr_<id>.md. The Cleared/Blocked banner and decision are pulled by the render script directly from the merge verdict, never from this file — the agent does not restate or decide the outcome here.

audit_narrative.description: The full chain-of-custody prose: story filed -> impact-analysis plan (+ approval) -> change implemented + compiled -> three Step 1 verdicts -> QA + build gate -> score -> decision. Every claim must link to its source document (already gathered in the chain facts) — do not restate a fact without its link.

pr_title.description: A single-line PR title, e.g. 'fix(employee-service): validate duplicate email via findByEmail (JIRA-002)'.

pr_summary.description: Bullet points for the PR body's summary section — what changed and why, written for a reviewer who has not read any of the upstream reports.

pr_test_plan.description: Checklist items for the PR body's test plan, drawn from what the QA and build gates actually ran (and what they could not, e.g. anything requiring a live dependency).

pr_additional_notes.description: Optional. Anything a reviewer should know that doesn't fit the summary or test plan — residual risk, deviations from the plan, open questions carried forward from upstream reports.
